🎬 House M.D. (2004–2012)

House M.D. follows Dr. Gregory House, a brilliant but unconventional medical genius who leads a team of diagnostic specialists at Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital in New Jersey. Known for his extraordinary intelligence, sharp sarcasm, and rebellious attitude, House specializes in solving mysterious medical cases that other doctors cannot explain. Despite his remarkable talent, his difficult personality, chronic leg pain, and dependence on pain medication frequently create conflicts with patients, colleagues, and hospital administrators. Working alongside a talented team of physicians, House investigates unusual symptoms, rare diseases, and life-threatening conditions, often challenging traditional medical procedures to uncover the truth. His belief that patients frequently hide important information leads him to question everyone and everything, creating intense situations filled with unexpected discoveries and shocking diagnoses. Meanwhile, his complicated friendship with Dr. James Wilson and ongoing disagreements with hospital administrator Dr. Lisa Cuddy reveal the emotional struggles beneath his sarcastic exterior. As the series progresses, House faces increasingly difficult challenges involving addiction, relationships, loneliness, professional responsibility, and the consequences of his own decisions. From fascinating medical mysteries and dramatic emergencies to hilarious conversations and heartbreaking moments, every episode explores the unpredictable nature of medicine and human behavior. Combining intelligent storytelling, dark humor, memorable characters, and compelling medical investigations, House M.D. explores morality, friendship, suffering, truth, personal growth, and the extraordinary mind of a doctor determined to solve the impossible.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 42–44 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: David Shore

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
